name: Auto Deco
description: Pick a theme and apply it to the whole level: background colours, animated pulses, screen shake, and a drifting background layer.

fade-in.name: Colour fade-in
fade-in.description: How many seconds the background colours take to fade in at the start of the level. 0 makes them instant.

pulse-density.name: Background pulse density
pulse-density.description: How often the accent colour pulses on the background channel. Off leaves the background static.

shake.name: Screen shake
shake.description: Let themes that ask for it add a short screen shake at the level start (Hell, Void, Toxic).

drift.name: Drift the selected objects
drift.description: If objects are selected in the editor when you apply a theme, they are put in the drift group and slowly move back and forth. Leave off if you only want colours and pulses.

drift-group.name: Drift group ID
drift-group.description: Group ID used for the drifting objects. Change it if 9999 is already used in your level.

drift-distance.name: Drift distance
drift-distance.description: How far the background layer moves, in editor units.
